items.title: Solo Ascension
items.description: A weak hunter wakes with the power to level up endlessly, hiding his growing strength from a world that once mocked him.

items.title: Titan's Wake
items.description: Humanity's last cities hide behind colossal walls, until a boy discovers he can become the very monsters that hunt them.

items.title: Ember Blade
items.description: A demon-slaying swordsman crosses a burning kingdom to find a cure for his transformed sister.

items.title: Quantum Pirates
items.description: A ragtag crew sails a sea of stars searching for a treasure that bends the laws of physics.

items.title: Nine Tailed Ronin
items.description: An exiled fox-spirit swordsman is pulled back into a clan war he swore to leave behind.

items.title: Crimson Exorcists
items.description: A brotherhood of exorcists battles ancient curses spilling out from a forgotten shrine.

items.title: Steel Vanguard
items.description: Teenage pilots defend a floating city using mechs built from salvaged alien tech.

items.title: Shadow Clan Chronicles
items.description: An outcast ninja seeks recognition from the village that once feared the beast sealed inside him.

items.title: Iron Fist Legacy
items.description: A washed-up boxer trains a prodigy for a tournament that could resurrect his own career.

items.title: Reborn in Another Realm
items.description: An office worker wakes up in a kingdom under siege, armed only with knowledge from his old life.

items.title: The Alchemist's Oath
items.description: Two brothers pay a terrible price for breaking alchemy's one absolute law, and spend years trying to undo it.

items.title: Skybound Academy
items.description: Students at a floating academy train to tame elemental spirits before an ancient storm returns.

items.title: Witch of the Frozen Spire
items.description: An immortal witch takes on an apprentice, knowing she will outlive him just like everyone before.

items.title: Corner Cafe Diaries
items.description: A small-town cafe becomes the meeting point for a cast of quietly hilarious regulars.

items.title: Rooftop Summers
items.description: Two rival student council members spend a summer discovering they might not be so different.

items.title: The Pottery Club
items.description: A quiet after-school club becomes the place where five students figure out who they want to be.

items.title: Neon Requiem
items.description: A hacker-for-hire uncovers a conspiracy buried in the code of the city's neural network.

items.title: Colony 9
items.description: The last human colony ship picks up a signal that shouldn't exist this far from Earth.

items.title: Chrono Drift
items.description: A time-displaced soldier relives the same invasion, shifting the outcome one loop at a time.
